patterns.note: The site uses a minimalist, centered layout for its hero section, with a single large brand name dominating the initial viewport, followed by full-width content sections that use grid layouts for product displays.

A striking, elegant serif typeface is used for the main brand identity and prominent section titles, creating a sophisticated and editorial feel, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
The primary color scheme is high-contrast black text on a pure white background, creating a very clean and stark aesthetic, with vibrant product imagery providing the main bursts of color.

The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while the large hero brand text scrolls up with the page content, maintaining a visual presence for a significant scroll depth due to its initial size and placement.

Content is organized into distinct, generously spaced sections, often introduced by a large title and a brief descriptive paragraph, followed by a grid of related items (e.g., coffee boxes, art pieces).

technique_notes: To achieve the persistent brand presence, design a hero section with a very large, centered text element that occupies significant vertical space, allowing it to scroll naturally but remain in view for a prolonged period. Implement a standard sticky header for the main navigation bar. Content sections should be full-width with generous vertical padding to create an airy, uncrowded feel, using CSS Grid for responsive item arrangements within sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, elegant serif for hero and section titles (~4-5x body text) paired with a clean, standard-sized sans-serif for body copy and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners everywhere, maintaining a crisp and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with very generous vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced density within content grids.

standout: The most distinctive element is the oversized, centered brand name in the hero section, which, despite scrolling, maintains a strong, almost persistent visual anchor for a significant portion of the initial page scroll. This creates a memorable and elegant brand-first impression that feels more like an art gallery than a typical e-commerce site.
